title: A*STAR Graduate Scholarship
institution: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) Graduate Academy
about: A*STAR scholarship funding PhD studies of up to four years at a Singapore autonomous university. The first application cycle opens 1 November and closes 1 February; interviews follow from mid-February to March, with outcomes from mid-April.
requirements: Singapore citizens or permanent residents: at least a Second-Class (Upper) Honours degree or equivalent in a relevant discipline (obtained or on track)
Non-SPR foreigners: completed or on track to obtain at least a Second-Class (Upper) Honours degree at a Singapore autonomous university
Must meet the criteria for, and gain admission to, a PhD programme at an autonomous university in Singapore
Non-SPR foreigners serve a three-year bond in a Singapore-based company; no bond for citizens and permanent residents

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Science and engineering PhD research" (field) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Must meet the criteria for, and gain admission to, a PhD programme at an autonomous university in Singapore" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
Doctoral-level research (seniority) → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
